name: smoke
description: Slice 0 parity smoke + Slice 1 UiLedger + Slice 2 dialogue-box/demo-opening checkpoints. Opens with the demo's frame-0 dialogue-only state (journey 0:00), dismisses the opening beat to materialize the grid (0:45), browses items so the description pane materializes on first cursor-rest (1:30) and the 3rd-unique-inspect fires the amnesia beat exactly once (a rapid re-scan proves no double-fire and no cursor leak), then repositions to (0,0) and runs the original mechanical smoke (cursor move+wrap, pick up, drop, look-in, one full craft, breadcrumb enter). Same file drives every --driver; checkpoint streams must diff clean and the invariant pack must stay green after every step. Dialogue text is asserted straight from data/dialogue/opening.md. Coordinates are pinned to the deterministic demo profile (GameInitializer.DemoSeed); a content change that shifts them is a deliberate script update (append-only history).

steps.comment: DEMO OPENING (journey 0:00) — frame 0 is the dialogue box alone: grid ledger-off, opening beat active. Pure assert (no action).
Dismiss the opening beat on Primary — the box drops and the world (grid) fades in (0:45).
BROWSE (journey 1:30) — first cursor-rest on an item materializes the description pane.
3rd unique item inspected → the amnesia beat fires (exactly once).

dialogue.line: I know what these are. Why don't I know where I am?

steps.comment: Rapid input while the beat shows: a non-Primary key is swallowed — cursor does NOT move (no leak) and the beat does not double-advance.
Scanning onto a brand-new unique item (4th) does NOT re-fire amnesia (fire-once).
Reposition the cursor back to (0,0) so the original mechanical smoke runs from its pinned start.
PICK UP — navigate to Plain Rock at (0,2) and grab it; the toolbar is born (FirstPickup)
DROP — move the cursor and drop the stack back onto its cell
LOOK IN — open the Workshop as a container panel; the look-in overlay materializes (FirstPeek)
CRAFT — deliver Plain Rock + Rough Wood into the Workshop and let it tick to a Workbench

BREADCRUMBS — enter the plain Belt Pouch at (1,0). Unlike the Workshop/Forest look-in panels (C/W), a plain bag pushes a breadcrumb — the FirstEnter trigger that materializes the breadcrumb line. Click positions the B cursor and enters in one gameplay action.
